== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Terminus Mundi refers to a specific type of [[memory manifestation magic]]. When cast as a spell, it creates a temporary pseudo-world that can exist as an endless expanse of darkness. This conjured environment is populated by [[inhabitants]] composed of blue light, specifically various eyes and hands that have been summoned or embedded into objects like asteroids. These anatomical components serve functional purposes; for example, certain eyes allow the user to perceive the flow of the [[Aether]]. The magic can also be used defensively or offensively, featuring celestial-looking eyes that cast various spells, such as hypnosis, petrification, or light-based attacks. While powerful enough to wear down opponents, the world created by this spell is not permanent and will eventually crack and collapse.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Terminus Mundi possesses the ability to manifest various physical forms, including multiple pairs of [[Aethril eyes]] and hands. These manifestations carry dangerous properties, as its eyes can cast visual illusions while its hands induce paralysis upon contact. During the events of this volume, the entity ultimately cracked and crumbled.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Terminus Mundi]] can manifest hands and eyes.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c44">''The Pilot'', chapter 44</ref>}}</li>
